text: 'Ship it safely' sounds right but isn't testable yet -- Vivian Castellan and Desmond Okoro turn it into one precise requirement.
EmberStake must correctly track staked and reward balances under real usage -- and under someone actively trying to break it.
It must also pass a dedicated internal security audit, including a real attempt to exploit it, before any real funds touch mainnet.
This doesn't claim the contract is already safe -- that's still the open question this whole series is building toward answering.
Next: scoping V1 -- exactly what ships, and what's deliberately deferred.
